suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as rare complication. Require acute pancreatitis and separately documented myocarditis/myocardial inflammatory injury temporally linked after exclusion of alternative causes. Rare case-based evidence; myocarditis is an uncommon reported complication, not a routine consequence. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Pancreatitis and Pericarditis / Endocarditis / Myocarditis
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes
Qualified clinical opinion before using population-level evidence as an individual nexus
